title: Pietro VS Nemo!
transcript: My opponent is a woman grandmaster, and I am a 1700 rated player. And we are playing a bullet game, which means that we only have 1 minute each for the entirety of our moves. But unfortunately, I'm quite a slow player, and bullet is Nemo's specialty. Which means that despite me gaining a pretty significant advantage on the board, I was getting absolutely destroyed on the clock. And because I get very low on time, despite having a crushing position, I have no time whatsoever to think about my moves, and I end up blundering a full rook in one move, forcing me to resign. But Nemo offers a rematch, and this time is going to be in blitz, which means that we are going to have 3 minutes each for our moves. But for some reason, we still decide to play extremely quickly. But this time the game is more in the balance, or at least it looks like it, all until this moment, where it seems like Nemo pins my knight and is going to win [music] it on the next move. But then I find a brilliant move. I am going to fork the rook and queen, and here I have a chance to win the game if I take with the knight, but I take with the queen. And all of a sudden she's completely winning again. I have no option but to resign the game, and so Nemo wins the match.
